items.question: Where has Christyn Williams played in the WNBA?
items.answer: The Washington Mystics drafted Christyn Williams in 2022, but she missed that season after knee surgery. She signed a hardship contract with the Phoenix Mercury late in 2023 without playing, then made her WNBA debut with the Dallas Wings in August 2025. Dallas signed her again in August 2026.

items.question: When was Christyn Williams drafted?
items.answer: The Washington Mystics took Christyn Williams in the second round, 14th overall, of the 2022 WNBA Draft out of UConn.

items.question: How did Christyn Williams do at UConn?
items.answer: Christyn Williams started for four seasons at UConn (2018-19 to 2021-22), averaging 11.7, 14.6, 16.3 and 14.2 points. As a senior she won the Ann Meyers Drysdale Award as the nation's top shooting guard, the first Husky to win it.

items.question: Where did Christyn Williams go to high school?
items.answer: Christyn Williams played at Central Arkansas Christian in North Little Rock, Arkansas. As a senior in 2018 she was the Naismith and Gatorade National Player of the Year and the McDonald's All-American Game MVP.

items.question: What are Christyn Williams's WNBA career averages?
items.answer: Christyn Williams averaged 2.6 points in seven WNBA regular-season games for Dallas over 2025 and 2026, including 4.3 points in four games in 2025.
